description: Source code for the NetworkManager plugin implementation in WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and connection handling.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Implements the network management plugin, handling initialization, cleanup, and connection events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers notifications, configures network manager, and registers JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications and methods, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles unexpected remote connection termination and triggers deactivation.
